roster.note: first uncrewed test flight — the capsule flies and returns before anyone rides it

roster.name: Shenzhou 5
roster.note: Yang Liwei orbits Earth 14 times — the first Chinese astronaut in space, and China becomes the third nation to launch a human on its own rocket, 42 years after Gagarin

roster.name: Shenzhou 7
roster.note: Zhai Zhigang performs China's first spacewalk — the third country ever to conduct an EVA

roster.name: Shenzhou 9
roster.note: first crewed docking, with Tiangong-1; Liu Yang becomes the first Chinese woman in space

roster.name: Shenzhou 11
roster.note: a 33-day stay aboard Tiangong-2 — China's longest crewed mission to that point, proving month-scale habitation

roster.name: Shenzhou 12
roster.note: the first crew to board the permanent Chinese Space Station; Shenzhou-14 (2022) begins continuous occupation

see_also.label: Tiangong — the station Shenzhou crews built and fly to
Soyuz — the vehicle Shenzhou's layout descends from
